mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_experience AND name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')AND status=#{status}AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM kb_experience WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM kb_experience WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_experience SET name=#{name},description=#{description},usage_notes=#{usageNotes},status=#{status},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT v.*,e.name FROM kb_experience_version v JOIN kb_experience e ON e.id=v.experience_id WHERE experience_id=#{experienceId} AND v.status=#{status} ORDER BY version_no DESC

SELECT v.id,v.experience_id,v.version_no,v.status,e.name FROM kb_experience_version v JOIN kb_experience e ON e.id=v.experience_id WHERE v.status='PUBLISHED' AND e.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.id DESC,v.version_no DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT v.*,e.name FROM kb_experience_version v JOIN kb_experience e ON e.id=v.experience_id WHERE v.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM kb_experience_version WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0)+1 FROM kb_experience_version WHERE experience_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_experience_version SET schema_version=#{schemaVersion},field_schema_json=#{fieldSchemaJson},default_values_json=#{defaultValuesJson},definition_json=#{definitionJson},definition_hash=#{definitionHash},change_note=#{changeNote},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

UPDATE kb_experience_version SET status='PUBLISHED',publish_by=#{publishBy},publish_time=NOW(),row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{publishBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT va.*,a.sha256,a.content_type mime_type FROM kb_experience_version_asset va JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=va.asset_id WHERE version_id=#{id} ORDER BY resource_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_render_job WHERE template_version_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until > NOW() FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job WHERE actor_user_id=#{actorUserId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job WHERE actor_user_id=#{actorUserId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM kb_question_source WHERE question_id IN #{id} ORDER BY source_id
SELECT id FROM kb_source WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM kb_render_job_item WHERE job_id=#{id} ORDER BY seq
SELECT ja.*,a.content_type mime_type FROM kb_render_job_asset ja JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=ja.asset_id WHERE job_id=#{id} ORDER BY resource_key

SELECT p.id product_id,p.asset_id,p.render_output_key output_key,a.sha256,pa.asset_id package_asset_id,pa.sha256 package_sha256 FROM kb_product p JOIN kb_asset a ON a.asset_id=p.asset_id LEFT JOIN kb_render_job_asset pa ON pa.job_id=p.render_job_id AND pa.resource_key=CONCAT('output:',p.render_output_key,':package') WHERE p.render_job_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT id FROM kb_render_job WHERE status='QUEUED' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_render_job SET status='RUNNING',lease_token=#{leaseToken},lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE),retry_count=retry_count+1,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=NOW(),error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND (status='QUEUED' OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < NOW()))
UPDATE kb_render_job SET lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL 3 MINUTE),update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken}

UPDATE kb_render_job SET status=#{status},renderer_fingerprint=#{rendererFingerprint},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},lease_until=NULL,lease_token=NULL,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{leaseToken}
UPDATE kb_render_job SET status='QUEUED',error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM kb_render_job j JOIN kb_render_job_asset a ON a.job_id=j.id WHERE a.asset_id=#{assetId} AND a.asset_role IN ('OUTPUT_PDF','OUTPUT_PACKAGE')
